title: Doctor Sim 3D
description: Step into the ER as a hands-on clinic doctor—diagnose quirky symptoms, apply bandages and treatments with satisfying 3D tools, and send every patient home smiling.
controls: Drag medical instruments onto highlighted treatment spots and follow on-screen prompts to heal each patient.

zh-CN.title: 趣味医生模拟器
zh-CN.description: 抖音爆火解压 3D 医生模拟：化身全能急诊大夫，用镊子听诊器与药水逐一治愈奇葩病例，强迫症看了极度舒适！
zh-CN.controls: 按提示拖动医疗器械对准病灶部位进行操作治疗，顺利治愈每一位前来就诊的病人。
